init.darwin: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; t=$(mktemp); trap "rm -f \"$t\"" EXIT; curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 180 https://chat-cdn.tcsl.com.cn/slclaw/workbuddy-cli-new/connector-runtime/21b2898d76ea542a370806cd/bootstrap.sh -o "$t"; h=$(shasum -a 256 "$t" | cut -d " " -f 1); test "$h" = 7bb063066c7345d0e87b0145c6f57d4bb9f0e7f5b141b6794088c27d9a13e47b || { echo installer-hash-mismatch >&2; exit 1; }; bash "$t"'
init.linux: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; t=$(mktemp); trap "rm -f \"$t\"" EXIT; curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 180 https://chat-cdn.tcsl.com.cn/slclaw/workbuddy-cli-new/connector-runtime/21b2898d76ea542a370806cd/bootstrap.sh -o "$t"; h=$(sha256sum "$t" | cut -d " " -f 1); test "$h" = 7bb063066c7345d0e87b0145c6f57d4bb9f0e7f5b141b6794088c27d9a13e47b || { echo installer-hash-mismatch >&2; exit 1; }; bash "$t"'
init.win32: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $t=Join-Path $env:TEMP ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('n')+'.ps1'); try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://chat-cdn.tcsl.com.cn/slclaw/workbuddy-cli-new/connector-runtime/21b2898d76ea542a370806cd/bootstrap.ps1' -OutFile $t -TimeoutSec 180; if (([BitConverter]::ToString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($t)))).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant() -ne '9990b71d4fccecc58ba3d4202204e717a77037e3dca5ede091a2322c5bd1c846') { throw 'installer-hash-mismatch' }; & $t } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $t -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
